scope: behavioral acceptance scenarios; automation does not establish human understanding

cases.name: first_move
cases.expected: Movement discovery follows actual walking and yields after completed input.

cases.name: first_interaction
cases.expected: Only the nearest actionable object receives a stable contextual key and actual result.

cases.name: first_echo_handoff
cases.expected: The first new Echo lands on its actual visible identity and remains findable after animation.

cases.name: second_encounter_exposure
cases.expected: Fresh encounter two primarily introduces Echo; later work is staged through known facts.

cases.name: first_complex_order
cases.expected: Advanced orders require familiar threats; daily mode does not depend on account knowledge.

cases.name: retirement_discovery
cases.expected: Retirement is discoverable before the first boss and retreats after actual use.

cases.name: move_and_autofire
cases.expected: Walking gait follows distance and is not restarted by each light shot.

cases.name: weapon_identity
cases.expected: Weapon material and trajectory remain recognizable without indiscriminate full-body reactions.

cases.name: enemy_hit_and_death
cases.expected: Brief hits and bounded form-specific death reactions do not obscure live threats.

cases.name: hurt_vs_block
cases.expected: Full absorption remains visually and audibly distinct from actual HP loss.

cases.name: charged_while_busy
cases.expected: A still-charged cue retries after a rejected accent; consumed state cancels the stale cue.

cases.name: ability_success_or_rejection
cases.expected: Accepted abilities show their actual result; rejected actions spend nothing and make no success pose.

cases.name: combo_first_and_repeat
cases.expected: First combo recognition has a readable interval; repeated same-type hits do not renew a permanent label.

cases.name: spawn_and_boss_warning
cases.expected: Spawn and boss warnings use locked authoritative geometry and remain above decorative ink.

cases.name: boss_phase_tear
cases.expected: Boss tension, seam break and release remain ordered and consistent with the actual phase.

cases.name: support_lifecycle
cases.expected: Support spawn/work/damage/expiry are readable while finite HP and charges remain truthful.

cases.name: manual_pickup_vs_settlement
cases.expected: Manual pickup energy and automatic cash settlement keep distinct consequences and feedback.

cases.name: concurrent_and_offscreen_feedback
cases.expected: Concurrent and offscreen routine events cannot displace the visible important result.

cases.name: future_echo_routes
cases.expected: Two-second future routes remain stable through holds, reflected tape time and reduced effects.

cases.name: persistent_echo_wear
cases.expected: Wear, silence and near-expiry remain static visible states instead of periodic flashing.

cases.name: active_vs_natural_retirement
cases.expected: Active retirement and natural exhaustion keep different causes and selected UID immediately follows a live body.

cases.name: held_echo_selection
cases.expected: Held selection pauses indefinitely; release selects only and cancellation restores the run.

cases.name: cleared_cohort_breather
cases.expected: A cleared cohort gets one real breather and one next-cohort transition.

cases.name: unfinished_work_after_clear
cases.expected: Empty combat identifies actual remaining work; a failed objective cannot keep a cleared field waiting.

cases.name: critical_result_before_transition
cases.expected: A first critical rescue/repair/ability closure gets a bounded window before a shop or reward covers it.

cases.name: pending_negotiation
cases.expected: Pending negotiation remains explicit and does not replay an introduction on reopen.

cases.name: deliberate_inspection
cases.expected: Mouse sweeps do not open inspection; deliberate dwell and controller focus remain useful.

cases.name: nested_reading
cases.expected: Nested rules never expire while being read and return focus through the hierarchy.

cases.name: purchase_and_upgrade
cases.expected: Purchases and upgrades commit immediately while actual slot/cost/grade results remain inspectable.

cases.name: repeated_blocked_purchase
cases.expected: Repeated identical refusal merges flavor reactions but continues identifying the real shortage.

cases.name: full_inventory_replacement
cases.expected: Full inventory replacement shows what leaves, enters and the actual net quote before commit.

cases.name: weapon_assembly
cases.expected: Assembly shows two actual inputs becoming the retained upgraded host and freed slot.

cases.name: weapon_evolution
cases.expected: Evolution compares actual old/new shape and attack role without a second confirmation layer.

cases.name: rapid_undo
cases.expected: Undo restores immediately and suppresses obsolete same-slot transaction effects.

cases.name: echo_binding_traits
cases.expected: Each Echo binding trait previews and confirms only its real condition/skill/grade change.

cases.name: reroll_latest_state
cases.expected: Rapid reroll shows only the current authoritative goods and prices without stale tooltips.

cases.name: player_death_closure
cases.expected: Player death keeps its finite paper fall before the summary without a coaching feature.

cases.name: exit_choice_and_victory
cases.expected: Exit previews and committed outcomes use only actual retained copies, survivors and staff UID.

cases.name: archive_candidate_and_replace
cases.expected: Archive reading has no timeout; novice focus is read-only and existing records default to preservation.

cases.name: familiar_restart_and_resume
cases.expected: Restart and resume retain completed familiarity without replaying obsolete transient events.
